snippet.title: Heroes Tactics - trailer (Fire Emblem crossover)
snippet.description:
You can play for free on Gamejolt:
https://gamejolt.com/games/heroes_tactics/1024100

Heroes Tactics is a fangame based on the Fire Emblem series, featuring a lot of different video games characters! 

Have you ever thought "What if Kratos fought Dimitri after Freddy killed a CoD soldier while Sans was watching from the sidelines"? No? Because we did! 
You can answer this very important question, as well as many others, by playing the game right now!

-------------------------------------------------------
This fangame and this video were created on a non-profit basis. All credits are detailed on the Gamejolt page.
Trailer music : "God shattering star" from Fire Emblem Three Houses.



#fireemblem #feh #fireemblemheores #fire_emblem #fireemblemfangame #fangame #fangames
